curriculum vitae: You should bring a printed copy of your curriculum vitae to the job interview.
面试时你应该带一份打印好的简历。
presentational: The report needs some presentational changes before we can show it to the manager.
这份报告需要做一些表达上的修改，才能呈交给经理。
IELTS: She spent six months preparing for the IELTS test before applying to university.
在申请上大学之前，她花了六个月准备雅思考试。
bureaucratic: The approval process is so bureaucratic that it takes weeks to get a simple answer.
审批流程太官僚了，得到一个简单的答复也要花上几个星期。
ethos: The school has a friendly ethos that encourages students to help each other.
这所学校有一种友善的风气，鼓励学生互相帮助。
minefield: Negotiating with suppliers can be a minefield for new managers who lack experience.
对于缺乏经验的新经理来说，与供应商谈判可能充满潜在的危险。
unwary: The contract hides extra charges that could easily catch unwary customers.
这份合同里藏着额外收费，很容易让不警惕的顾客上当。
build on: We hope to build on this year's success and attract more customers.
我们希望在今年的成功基础上更进一步，吸引更多顾客。
to tell you the truth: To tell you the truth, I never really enjoyed studying law at all.
老实说，我从来没有真正喜欢过学法律。
infantile paralysis: The vaccine has almost wiped out infantile paralysis in many countries.
这种疫苗在许多国家几乎消灭了小儿麻痹症。
Rosalyn: Rosalyn helped her grandmother plant roses in the garden last weekend.
上周末罗莎琳帮她的祖母在花园里种玫瑰。
Sally: Sally borrowed two books from the library and returned them on time.
萨利从图书馆借了两本书，并按时归还了。
Marty: Marty fixed the broken bicycle so that his sister could ride to school.
马蒂修好了坏掉的自行车，好让妹妹能骑车上学。
in other words: He was fired because he was often late; in other words, he lacked discipline.
他被解雇是因为经常迟到；换句话说，他缺乏纪律。
adapt to: It takes most students a few months to adapt to life in a new city.
大多数学生需要几个月才能适应新城市的生活。
out of breath: After running up the stairs, she was out of breath for several minutes.
跑上楼梯后，她好几分钟都上气不接下气。
annoyance: The constant noise from the street became a real annoyance for the family.
街上持续不断的噪音成了这家人真正的烦恼。
sit around: Don't sit around all day waiting for opportunities to come to you.
不要整天闲坐着等机会自己找上门来。
tortoise: The tortoise walked slowly across the garden and hid under a large leaf.
那只乌龟慢慢爬过花园，躲到了一片大叶子下面。
in many ways: In many ways, learning a language is like learning to play an instrument.
在很多方面，学一门语言就像学一种乐器。
psychologically: Preparing for exams is hard psychologically, so students need enough rest and support.
备考在心理上很煎熬，所以学生需要充分的休息和支持。
make fun of: It is unkind to make fun of someone who is speaking a foreign language.
取笑说外语的人是不厚道的。
fulfilling: Working as a nurse is tiring, but many people find it deeply fulfilling.
当护士很累，但很多人觉得这份工作非常令人满足。
never mind: Never mind the broken cup; I have plenty of others in the kitchen.
别担心那个打碎的杯子，厨房里还有很多别的杯子。
Barry Minto: Barry Minto organized a charity climb to raise money for the local hospital.
巴里•明托组织了一次慈善登山活动，为当地医院筹款。
Mount Kilimanjaro: Climbing Mount Kilimanjaro took the team almost a week because of the weather.
由于天气原因，攀登乞力马扎罗山花了这支队伍将近一个星期。
bowling: We usually go bowling on Friday evenings when we finish work early.
我们通常在周五傍晚提前下班后去打保龄球。
all the best: All the best with your new job; I hope everything goes well for you.
祝你新工作一切顺利，希望你万事如意。
Sanders: Mrs. Sanders has taught mathematics at this school for more than ten years.
桑德斯太太在这所学校教数学已经十多年了。
earphone: He wore only one earphone so that he could still hear the phone ringing.
他只戴了一只耳机，这样他仍然能听见电话铃声。
meet with: The manager will meet with the new staff to discuss their training plans.
经理将与新员工会面，讨论他们的培训计划。
italics: The titles of books are usually printed in italics in academic papers.
在学术论文中，书名通常用斜体印刷。
Isaac Asimov: Isaac Asimov wrote hundreds of science books and stories during his long career.
艾萨克•阿西莫夫在漫长的职业生涯中写了几百本科普书和故事。
Larry Belmont: Larry Belmont promised to send us the report before the end of the month.
拉里•贝尔蒙特答应在月底前把报告发给我们。
test out: The engineers need to test out the new robot before putting it into service.
工程师们需要先试验这台新机器人，再让它投入使用。
Claire: Claire invited her classmates to celebrate her birthday at home on Saturday.
克莱尔邀请同学们周六到家里庆祝她的生日。
alarmed: She was alarmed by the strange noise coming from the empty kitchen.
空厨房里传来的奇怪声音让她很惊慌。
apron: Mother put on her apron before she started to cook the dinner.
妈妈系上围裙后才开始做晚饭。
Gladys Claffern: Gladys Claffern was the richest woman in town, and everyone respected her.
格拉迪斯•克拉芬是镇上最有钱的女人，人人都尊敬她。
fingernail: She tapped her fingernail on the table while waiting for the doctor.
等医生的时候，她用手指甲轻轻敲着桌子。
